items.q: We need more ______ about the new spec.
items.note: information 不可數：沒 a 沒 s。
feedback 不可數。要數用 a comment / some comments。
一條一條的成品 → 可數，加 s。

items.q: We have made a lot of ______ on this project.（進度）
items.note: progress 不可數，a lot of progress。

items.q: Our team has ten years of ______ in cable assembly.
items.note: 累積的經驗是一團 → 不可數。

groups.title: B　a / an / the / 不加

items.q: We received ______ complaint yesterday. ______ complaint is about the pitch.（兩格各填一字）
items.note: 第一次提 a，再提 the。

items.q: Please check ______ drawing you sent yesterday.
items.note: 後面有「你昨天寄的」限定是哪一張 → the。

items.q: We need ______ approval before we ship.
items.note: approval 不可數、泛指 → 不加。

items.q: The meeting will take about ______ hour.
items.note: hour 的 h 不發音，母音開頭 → an。

items.q: This is ______ best option for the customer.
Please send the revised file to ______.
items.note: 介係詞後面用「被打到」的形式 me。

items.q: We tested the samples. ______ all passed.
We don't need the old sample; we need the new ______.
我會親自確認那份報價。
